message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "visual_progression_assessment_over_classifier_scores", "description": "When assessing disease progression or resolution across multiple chest X-rays, do not rely on differences in classifier confidence scores as they are uncalibrated and do not reflect clinical severity changes.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving the comparison of two or more chest X-ray images to determine temporal changes in pathology (e.g., progression, improvement, or stability).", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If comparing multiple chest X-rays for disease evolution: (1) Ignore minor fluctuations in classifier output scores (e.g., Lung Opacity 0.88 vs 0.89) as they are not calibrated measures of severity; (2) Perform a direct visual comparison of the original image files to identify spatial changes such as new opacities, consolidation resolution, or volume loss; (3) Explicitly bind each finding to its source filename to establish a clear chronological narrative."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
